title: O.T.I.S. Beta v.1
author: verbalbacklash
selftext:
I thought I would share with this group as well. This is my 1st game building in Godot using various AI agents to help me learn. This is kind of a passion fun project to help me learn but I thought I would share it to multiple places and see what people think. Please let me know if you have constructive criticism, like it , dislike it , or just anything really. Just trying to get some more opinions on the concept and what not. I mainly used Codex for this project though I did a 2d prototype 1st to rough out the idea.    
  
Here are the links to OTIS BETA v.1 , thanks to those who gave feedback in discord on the demo.

replies.body: Thanks. I felt it added a certain annoyance that I couldn't just put my finger on.

comments.author: Yenii_3025
comments.body: The text going outside of the chat cards makes me angry

replies.author: verbalbacklash
replies.body: Right. I agree. Perfection is the enemy of progress. Should be my theme for this game. But you are correct.

comments.author: forrestwear
comments.body: this trailer is terrible. the context of whatever the voice is talking about has nothing to do with what is happening on screen. the circus music loop you have going on in the back is annoying. the voice mentions toast around the 50 second mark, but the actual clip showcases it around the 19 second mark. the game doesn't show anything besides picking up a crate. 2/10 at best

replies.author: verbalbacklash
replies.body: Thanks for the input all correct evaluation of the trailer. I would say in defense it's kinda supposed to be that way to mimic an early as seen on tv commercial but it is a fair point I thought about changing the order of voice to match but after watching several times it kinda grew on me. I think the theme of the whole game is going to be kinda jackey slap dash dev considering the source. Either way thanks for the feedback. Dislikes are welcome as much as likes.
